name: Entity Version Workflows
description: Bumps, decreases or resets entity version numbers automatically on Content Moderation workflow state transitions.
project_description: Sub-module of Entity Version. Integrates with core Content Moderation / Workflows so that each workflow transition can be configured to increase, decrease, reset or leave unchanged each of the major/minor/patch numbers of a bundle's main version field. Per-transition rules are stored as workflow third-party settings (added via a form_alter on the transition add/edit forms) and applied in hook_entity_presave by EntityVersionWorkflowManager, which resolves the transition being used and optionally applies the rules only when the entity's field values changed. Entities can opt out per save with the entity_version_no_update flag; reverting a node revision keeps the version unchanged.
